name: Level 30: Self-Hosting Compiler Bootstrapper
description: The Ultimate 30th Milestone Level! Write a mini-compiler in RoboASM that compiles high-level token stream [101, 10, 102, 5, 103, 999] into target bytecode! Translation Rules: Token 101->Bytecode 1 (MOV), Token 102->Bytecode 2 (ADD), Token 103->Bytecode 9 (HLT). Literals pass through untouched. Output compiled binary payload to Outbox (4,1)!
